nodes.label: §1 Why this plan exists
nodes.rationale: The reference medical project licenses only narrow claims (memory parity with FlashAttention at 16K, 1.34x compiled inference, 5.19x O(1) cached decode, -16% PPL repair of two defective recurrences, seed parity with a matched Transformer); the blueprint concludes the defensible contribution for a legal system is the package, not the mixer.

nodes.label: §4 Baselines every arm is measured against
nodes.rationale: Reference H100 numbers (122.90 ms / 7.169 GB compiled chunk 128 at L=16,384; 157.6 tok/s cached decode; screen and stage-0 PPL) are sanity checks for P4 and the yardstick for P9's efficiency table, never the legal model's quality numbers.

nodes.label: §6 Compute and storage budget
nodes.rationale: Estimates only (screen arm 6–10 h; full backbone 1–2 days on 4xH100; checkpoint ~4.3 GB; <= 40 GB of checkpoints kept); P4 replaces them with measurements.

nodes.label: §7 Phases
nodes.rationale: Every phase: purpose, where it runs, boxes, one Gate; sbatch boxes come in submit/verdict pairs needing --evidence job=<id>; Pn-Z is always the gate box; USER ACTION boxes stop the session.

nodes.label: §8 Testing and continuous integration
nodes.rationale: Testing is part of every box, not a phase; three venues (Mac, GitHub Actions, aisc cluster) and each check runs where it has what it needs.

nodes.label: §10 State-tracking contract
nodes.rationale: After every meaningful change the checkbox is ticked through the helper; the checkboxes are ground truth and the JSON is the resumable record; commands are written python3 scripts/... so they are never pasted into the login node.

nodes.label: P0 — Plan of record
nodes.rationale: Create plan, state, helper, bootstrap, port map, template and README on the Mac with no GPU and no downloads.

nodes.label: P1 — Bootstrap and faithful port
nodes.rationale: A runnable lexhybrid package whose blocks compute exactly what the reference blocks compute (renames only: cu_seqlens -> doc_ids); defects are NOT fixed here so the parity test can hold.

nodes.label: P2 — Correctness fixes, decoder deltas, legal configs
nodes.rationale: Fix the 18 recorded defects and add what a legal decoder needs (attention KV cache, one-pass prefill, EOS/pointer decoding, boundary-masked loss, slab-wise KL); parity fixtures stay green wherever a fix does not touch the fixture configuration.

nodes.label: P3 — Data pipeline at smoke scale
nodes.rationale: Every data component exists, is tested on fixtures, and runs end to end on <= 1 GB of downloads; nothing needs the cluster.

nodes.label: P4 — Cluster bring-up, corpus at scale, profiling
nodes.rationale: Reach the aisc cluster without git, build the environment, fetch weights, build the corpus at scale, and measure before training; the teacher is decided by measurement (P4-U).

nodes.label: P5 — Pre-registered screen
nodes.rationale: Choose the backbone configuration by measurement, one lever per arm, 1 H100 per arm, 12,000 steps at 2,048-token rows, seeds 42 and 43; the decision rule is written before the numbers.

nodes.label: P6 — Full backbone pretraining
nodes.rationale: The backbone the whole system stands on: 4xH100 DDP, ~262K tokens/step at 4,096 rows (stage A, 90% of budget) then 8,192 rows (stage B, last 10%); P7 is worked locally while jobs run.

nodes.label: P7 — Retrieval, renderer, verifier
nodes.rationale: The system around the decoder, built from the P3 schema while P6 trains; nothing unverified reaches the user.

nodes.label: P8 — Post-training
nodes.rationale: Teach the pointer format, refusal and stopping: SFT -> DPO/KTO -> GRPO only if the pre-registered condition holds; seeds 42/43/44 for hybrid and Transformer, 1 seed for Qwen3-0.6B.

nodes.label: P9 — Evaluation, benchmarks, writeup
nodes.rationale: The thesis table with every pre-registered prediction next to its outcome; no claim from one seed; every number carries a job id and a log path.

nodes.label: P10 — Release hygiene
nodes.rationale: Make the repo and its claims honest and reproducible; hand the git decision to the user (P10-F release commit, P10-G CI green).

nodes.label: P11 — Optional: Qwen3 conversion road
nodes.rationale: The only road to frontier-competitive knowledge (blueprint §Scale); not scheduled, opened only on user instruction after P9; staying pending forever is correct.

nodes.label: Resume rule
nodes.rationale: Every session starts with plan_state.py resume and reads only the phase it prints; checkboxes are ground truth; tick through the helper, never by hand.

nodes.label: Repository rule (git belongs to the user)
nodes.rationale: The user initialised the repository (remote origin github.com/krishankb-de/legal_ai_hybrid_mamba_xlstm_model) and decides every commit and push; the implementing model runs no git command unless asked and never pushes.

nodes.label: Reference rule
nodes.rationale: Reference/hybrid_model_mamba_xlstm is read-only, deleted at P1-Z by the user, never read again; Docs/REFERENCE_PORT_MAP.md carries what the port needs.

nodes.label: Login node executes nothing scripted
nodes.rationale: Only sbatch/squeue/sacct/scancel/cat/tail/grep/ls/du/df/mkdir on the aisc login node; ARM is resolved inside the job; #SBATCH --gpus=N in a file is not overridden by env, so a 4-GPU run needs --gpus=4 on the sbatch line and its own wrapper; --gres is never used; ga03 (ARM) and gx13v1 (faulty GPU) stay excluded.

nodes.label: The package, not the mixer
nodes.rationale: The defensible unique contribution is a corrected hybrid decoder that never generates statute text, cites by pointer into a numbered retrieved context, and is gated by a verifier, evaluated on DACH law; not a claim that the hybrid mixer beats attention.

nodes.label: USER ACTION box
nodes.rationale: A USER ACTION box stops the session; it is ticked only with --user-confirmed after the user acted; until then the phase is blocked.

nodes.label: R1 Equivalence
nodes.rationale: Any operator change (ssd_chunked_scan, TFLA, selective scan, decode step) passes the fp64-oracle gate at rel-max-err <= 1e-6 and the model-logit gate at <= 1e-4 (check_operator_equivalence.py) before it is ticked.

nodes.label: R2 Memory
nodes.rationale: No change regresses the inference memory result (parity with FlashAttention at 16K, reference 7.09 vs 7.15 GB); P4 measures it and P9 re-measures it.

nodes.label: R3 One lever per arm
nodes.rationale: Every arm differs from its control in exactly one named lever; arms that are not parameter-matched carry their delta in every table.

nodes.label: R4 Predict first
nodes.rationale: Every measurement phase opens with an italic pre-registered prediction and a bar written before the job is submitted; the RESULTS block reports prediction -> outcome including wrong ones.

nodes.label: R5 Seed band before claim
nodes.rationale: Two seeds per screen arm, three for any claim; no t-test on two degrees of freedom.

nodes.label: R6 Checkpoint budget
nodes.rationale: SAVE_TOP_K=0 on every arm, 1 + last.ckpt on pipeline inputs; outputs/ on $SCRATCH_ROOT never $HOME; du before every submission.

nodes.label: R7 One compiler cache per measured point
nodes.rationale: Every torch.compile number is measured one shape per process with its own TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR; the profiler prints the chunk size read back off the module.

nodes.label: R8 No legacy operators
nodes.rationale: Legacy operators only in hybrid_legal_legacy.yaml and the ref_* replicas; every recurrent yaml pins tfla_impl (and scan_impl when it has Mamba-1 layers) explicitly.

nodes.label: R9 Licence discipline
nodes.rationale: Every document carries licence, jurisdiction, commercial_safe; build_corpus refuses licence=unknown; research_only never enters a commercial_safe shard; no checkpoint trained with research_only data leaves the cluster.

nodes.label: R10 No API-model training data
nodes.rationale: Never train on GPT/Claude/Gemini API outputs; synthetic data comes from open-weight teachers only.

nodes.label: R11 Personal data
nodes.rationale: LER scrub (PER, RR, AN, STR) runs before pretraining and before any index build; the verifier rejects answers naming a PER entity; 'who was the party' is a refusal.

nodes.label: R12 Provenance
nodes.rationale: Every number in analysis/ carries a job id and a log path; every model logs its ARCH fingerprint; every run writes run_metadata.json with the .sync_stamp tree hash and the commit id read from .git/HEAD as a file; 'tooling is not a tick — the gate is the measurement'.

nodes.label: R13 Tests with the code
nodes.rationale: A box that adds or changes code adds or changes its tests in the same box; every test belongs to a layer and marker; skips carry reasons; the coverage floor is never lowered without a note; an intermittent test is a defect.

nodes.label: R14 One gate, three venues
nodes.rationale: validate.sh --ci and the CI test job run the same pytest selection; checks the Mac cannot run are listed in §8.3 and run in CI or on the cluster; a red CI run blocks the current box.

nodes.label: OFAT ablation ladder
nodes.rationale: One-factor-at-a-time, not factorial: S1 is the base and control; every other screen arm flips one lever against it; arms whose lever changes the parameter count are reported with the delta.

nodes.label: Simplest-arm decision rule (P5)
nodes.rationale: Written before the numbers: the simplest arm advances unless another beats it on two-seed mean val PPL by more than the bar AND does not lose statute-recall or multi-hop by more than the bar; a lever that wins PPL but loses recall is recorded and not adopted.

nodes.label: Claim rule (decision 16)
nodes.rationale: 2 seeds per screen arm, 3 seeds for any claim; claim = paired mean > one baseline seed SD AND sign at >= 2/3 seeds; bootstrap CIs (1,000 resamples by question) beside, never instead.

nodes.label: Screen bar (2x seed SD, floor 0.10 PPL)
nodes.rationale: bar_value = max(2 x two-seed SD of S1, 0.10 PPL); S1 seeds run first so the bar exists before the other arms; if the floor binds, say so (FL11 underpowered screen).

nodes.label: Pre-registered prediction
nodes.rationale: Each measurement phase (P4–P9) opens with an italic prediction written before submission; P9-Z requires every prediction reported beside its outcome.

nodes.label: Decision 1: initialisation road (from scratch first)
nodes.rationale: From scratch with the Qwen3 tokenizer and logit-KL from an open Qwen3-*-Base teacher; Qwen3 conversion is P11, optional, on user instruction only.

nodes.label: Decision 2: corpus with commercial-safe and research-exception arms
nodes.rationale: Open-licensed sources plus a research-exception arm; every document carries licence and commercial_safe; research_only documents never enter a shippable arm.

nodes.label: Decision 3: GPUs
nodes.rationale: 1 H100 per screen arm; 4 H100 DDP for full backbone and SFT runs.

nodes.label: Decision 11: parameter counting
nodes.rationale: non_embedding = total - embedding - (lm_head if untied); both counts always reported; the base is 104.1M non-embedding / 220.8M total and is never called '150M'.

nodes.label: Decision 12: sequence lengths
nodes.rationale: Screens at 2,048-token rows; main pretraining at 4,096; long-context stage at 8,192; 32K/128K numbers are efficiency-only.

nodes.label: Decision 15: ceilings
nodes.rationale: Large open model gpt-oss-120b with the same passages (Qwen3-235B does not fit 4x80 GB) or skipped and said so; a frontier API only as an optional USER ACTION and never as training data.

nodes.label: Decision 20: S5 parameter band
nodes.rationale: The legacy recipe's +2.36% non-embedding is a stated difference inside +-2.5%, not reshaped (the pre-registered <= 1% did not hold for 9xmamba + 3xmlstm); S5 stays PPL/probe-only; a hybrid win is conservative, a legacy win inside the margin inconclusive.

nodes.label: Decision 21: S5 forget bias 3.0
nodes.rationale: S5's one lever is the legacy operator, so mlstm_forget_gate_bias_init stays at the base's 3.0; the reference's effective 0.0 came from defect 3, and at 0.0 the kernel falls onto its sequential path at chunk 128.

nodes.label: lexhybrid package
nodes.rationale: Package name lexhybrid; Python >= 3.11; PyTorch >= 2.5; pytorch_lightning >= 2.4; Hydra; editable install, no sys.path shims; subpackages config, layers, kernels, models, decoding, data, training, retrieval, verifier, renderer, eval, utils.

nodes.label: HybridLanguageModel
nodes.rationale: embedding -> 12 x HybridBlock -> RMSNorm -> tied LM head; forward, architecture_fingerprint, generate, allocate_inference_cache, step_logits, prefill, generate_cached, reorder_cache, beam_search_cached, get_num_params.

nodes.label: HybridBlock
nodes.rationale: pre-norm -> mixer -> residual; HybridNorm post-norm FFN from block 1; mixer chosen by layer_pattern; strips mamba3_/mlstm_ option prefixes (defect 2 fixed in P2-A).

nodes.label: HybridNorm topology
nodes.rationale: norm_topology hybrid: pre-norm mixer with post-residual FFN norm from block 1 onward.

nodes.label: RMSNorm (fp32 compute)
nodes.rationale: P2-E: computes in fp32 and casts back (defect 10); changes fp32 numerics below 1e-6 only.

nodes.label: Layer pattern M3 M3 M3 A L L L M3 M3 A M3 M3
nodes.rationale: Decision 10: 12 layers, dim 768, 12 heads, d_state 128, chunk 128 for Mamba-3 and mLSTM, rope_theta 500000, dropout 0, tied embeddings, max_position_embeddings 8192.

nodes.label: Mamba-3 mixer (Mamba-2 SSD)
nodes.rationale: Scalar-A per head, d_state 128, boundary masks inside the scan; forward writes ssm_state, conv_state, seen, B_prev/x_prev, angle_state into the cache (P2-F).

nodes.label: mLSTM mixer (exact TFLA)
nodes.rationale: Exact TFLA with boundary masks inside the kernel after P2-D; post_model_init re-applies gate-bias inits after _init_weights (defect 3); step keeps C, n in fp32.

nodes.label: Sparse attention mixer
nodes.rationale: Two attention layers (positions 3 and 9): RoPE with per-document positions, flex-attention block mask in packed training, KV cache in decode; attn0/attn4 screen arms vary the count.

nodes.label: Mamba-1 legacy mixer (ablation only)
nodes.rationale: Legacy Mamba-1 with scan_impl legacy/exact; used only by hybrid_legal_legacy (S5) and kept PPL/probe-only because no cached decode exists for it.

nodes.label: ssd_chunked_scan kernel
nodes.rationale: Returns (y, final_state) with seg padded by the last real id and the .item() sync removed (defect 7); state allocated in fp32 (defect 16); fp64 oracle ssd_sequential_reference.

nodes.label: TFLA kernel (exact / legacy)
nodes.rationale: apply_tfla takes chunk_size from the block (defect 9); _EXP_SAFE fallback is a config-time choice tfla_fallback error|sequential, default error, so the factorised fast path must hold at init (forget bias 3.0); returns (h, C_final, n_final).

nodes.label: Selective scan kernel
nodes.rationale: selective_scan, selective_scan_parallel, selective_scan_exact with an fp64 reference; legacy cases are xfail(strict=True).

nodes.label: RoPE with per-document positions
nodes.rationale: Positions restart at each doc_ids boundary; _rope_tables rebuilt with self.rope_theta (defect 8); default rope_theta 500000.

nodes.label: FlexAttention block mask from doc_ids
nodes.rationale: Packed training attention via torch.nn.attention.flex_attention with a block mask from doc_ids (defect 18); dense-mask path kept as CPU/reference fallback; predicted within 1.2x of unpacked SDPA time.

nodes.label: Packed rows with doc_ids
nodes.rationale: Rows carry doc_ids (B, L); every mixer resets state where the id changes; the loss masks the prediction across a boundary; renamed from the reference's cu_seqlens.

nodes.label: Boundary-masked loss
nodes.rationale: shift_labels[doc_ids[:,1:] != doc_ids[:,:-1]] = -100, EOS supervised, n_supervised_tokens logged (defect 6); the same label mask applies to KL.

nodes.label: Attention KV cache
nodes.rationale: AttentionBlock.step with {k, v, seen}; RoPE at position seen; attend over [:seen+1]; reorder_cache over attention caches for beam search (defects 5, 11).

nodes.label: Cached decode (one-pass prefill, O(1) step)
nodes.rationale: One-pass prefill from each mixer's carried state; O(1) per-token step for recurrent mixers, KV append for attention; greedy/sample/beam over the cache with EOS stop and repetition penalty; cached = uncached in fp32 and argmax-identical in bf16.

nodes.label: PointerFSM
nodes.rationale: Given the retrieved set {(c, [s...])}, masks <|cK|> ids not retrieved and <|sJ|> ids not in the current chunk, and requires <|q|>/<|cite|> before a <|cK|>; tested to never emit an unretrieved pointer over 1,000 random steps.

nodes.label: Pointer citations <|q|><|cK|><|sJ|>
nodes.rationale: The decoder never generates statute text; it emits pointers into a numbered retrieved context (<|q|><|cK|><|sJ|> for a quote, <|cite|><|cK|> for a label) and the renderer inserts the exact sentence and its citation_id.

nodes.label: Added special tokens (SFT only)
nodes.rationale: Decision 7: <|q|>, <|cite|>, <|c1|>..<|c16|>, <|s1|>..<|s64|>, <|unanswerable|>, <|passage|>, <|/passage|>, <|question|>, <|answer|> (87 tokens <= 267 free ids); never used in KD.

nodes.label: best_of_n hook
nodes.rationale: n cached samples, returns the scorer's argmax; the P7 verifier is the scorer; also the source of DPO pairs in P8.

nodes.label: Multi-token-prediction head
nodes.rationale: mtp_n=2, mtp_loss_weight, off by default, shares the tied embedding; bit-identical when off; the S4 screen lever.

nodes.label: ARCH fingerprint
nodes.rationale: Logged at construction by every model; prints params= and params_nonembed=; screen wrappers grep it at step 0 against the arm's expect tokens and exit non-zero on mismatch (FL1 silent config drop).

nodes.label: run_metadata.json
nodes.rationale: Reference fields minus git_*, plus sync_stamp read from .sync_stamp and tree_hash over lexhybrid/ configs/ scripts/; commit id read from .git/HEAD as a file, never by running git.

nodes.label: load_state_dict_guarded
nodes.rationale: Hard-fails when > 50% of keys are missing, warns above 5%; strip_prefixes handles model.-prefixed checkpoint keys.

nodes.label: Online logit-KD loss (slab_ce_kl)
nodes.rationale: (1-a)*CE + a*T^2*KL(teacher_T || student_T), a=0.5, T=2, computed per 512-token slab under activation checkpointing so (B,L,V) is never materialised (FL8); teacher receives per-document position_ids and a block-diagonal mask; the doc-boundary label mask applies to KL too.

nodes.label: Qwen3 teacher (1.7B default, 8B by measurement)
nodes.rationale: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B-Base by default; Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base only if P4-U measures peak <= 70 GB at 4,096 rows and step time <= 1.6x the 1.7B step.

nodes.label: Qwen3 tokenizer (EOS 151643, vocab 151936)
nodes.rationale: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B-Base tokenizer; EOS is Qwen3's own <|endoftext|> so the teacher's target at document ends is meaningful; student vocab_size 151936; specials must fit (len <= 151936).

nodes.label: WSD schedule
nodes.rationale: Warmup-stable-decay; at 120,000 steps and warmup 2,000: D=16,800, S=101,200, decay start 103,200; stage B re-anchors the decay to the combined horizon.

nodes.label: PretrainLightningModule
nodes.rationale: CE + optional KL, WSD, beta2 anneal, manual clip, compile_model honoured, NaN guard skips the optimizer step, DDPStrategy(find_unused_parameters=False, gradient_as_bucket_view=True), val_check_interval = val_every_opt_steps x accumulate_grad_batches asserted (defect 12), resume from ckpt_path.

nodes.label: HybridLightningModule
nodes.rationale: Ported from the reference: training_step, validation_step, configure_optimizers with wsd/cosine/linear/constant, manual clip_grad_norm_, beta2 anneal.

nodes.label: SignalCheckpointCallback
nodes.rationale: Writes a checkpoint on the preemption signal so requeue resumes from last.ckpt (FL5).

nodes.label: torch.compile measurement discipline
nodes.rationale: One length per process with a fresh TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR (R7); effective_chunk_size read back off the module; compile drift found on GPU in job 2588779 (README commit history).

nodes.label: Chunk-size rule
nodes.rationale: 128 unless it fails R1 or loses > 5% at 4,096 (P4-Q).

nodes.label: The 18 recorded defects
nodes.rationale: Recorded in the port map §15 with reference line numbers; preserved in P1 for parity, each fixed with its own regression test in P2 (e.g. mlstm_ prefix drop, gate-bias init lost, TFLA chunk size, boundary masks, RMSNorm dtype, rope_theta, KV cache, val_check_interval, init-then-tie, flex attention).

nodes.label: Document schema (lexhybrid/data/schema.py)
nodes.rationale: Document(id, source, jurisdiction, doc_type, licence, commercial_safe, valid_from, valid_to, citation_id, url, sha256, retrieved_at, text, sections[Section(label, absatz, satz_idx, randnummer, text)]) with to_json/from_json; described in Docs/DOCUMENT_SCHEMA.md.

nodes.label: citation_id grammar
nodes.rationale: BGB §573 Abs. 2 Nr. 1, ABGB §1295, OR Art. 97, BGH VIII ZR 12/20 Rn. 14.

nodes.label: Licence discipline (licence / commercial_safe / research_only)
nodes.rationale: Every document carries licence, jurisdiction, commercial_safe; unknown licences are refused; research_only never enters a commercial_safe shard (test in validate.sh); the register is the single source (FL3).

nodes.label: Docs/CORPUS_LICENCE_REGISTER.md
nodes.rationale: One row per source: name, jurisdiction, doc types, licence, commercial-safe, gated?, URL, access method; final in P10-C with every version date.

nodes.label: Collector protocol
nodes.rationale: class Collector(Protocol): name, licence, jurisdiction; iter_documents(limit); shared http_get with retry/backoff and rate limit; manifest.py writes data/manifests/<source>.jsonl; every collector ships an offline fixture test and a network-marked live smoke.

nodes.label: Collector GII (gesetze-im-internet.de)
nodes.rationale: Federal statutes, XML, amtliches Werk §5 UrhG; captures Stand date, §, Absatz, Satz; jurisdiction DE.

nodes.label: Collector RII (rechtsprechung-im-internet.de)
nodes.rationale: Federal court decisions; Tenor/Tatbestand/Gründe; Randnummern.

nodes.label: Collector OLDP (openlegaldata.io)
nodes.rationale: ODbL-1.0; court, date, ECLI.

nodes.label: Collector EUR-Lex
nodes.rationale: German language, CC BY 4.0 reuse notice; CELEX id, Artikel; jurisdiction EU.

nodes.label: Collector RIS (Austrian Rechtsinformationssystem)
nodes.rationale: CC BY 4.0; Bundesrecht + Judikatur; Inkrafttreten dates; jurisdiction AT.

nodes.label: Collector Fedlex (Swiss federal law)
nodes.rationale: Open; SR number, Artikel; versions; jurisdiction CH.

nodes.label: Collector BGer (Swiss Federal Supreme Court)
nodes.rationale: CC BY 4.0 as published; Erwägungen; jurisdiction CH.

nodes.label: Collector DIP (Bundestag documentation)
nodes.rationale: Open; Drucksachen; doc_type parliament.

nodes.label: Collector FineWeb-2 deu_Latn
nodes.rationale: HF datasets streaming, ODC-By 1.0; general-German replay; doc_type general; commercial_safe true.

nodes.label: Collector MultiLegalPile NC subsets
nodes.rationale: HF, gated; research_only true, commercial_safe false; needs HF_TOKEN (P4-B).

nodes.label: GerLeRB eval set
nodes.rationale: Retrieval queries/qrels; eval only; licence recorded; nDCG@10 >= 0.45 predicted.

nodes.label: GerDaLIR eval set
nodes.rationale: Retrieval queries/qrels; eval only; nDCG@10 >= 0.35 predicted.

nodes.label: LegalQuAD eval set
nodes.rationale: QA; eval only; LegalQuAD-style items feed SFT data with eval sets excluded.

nodes.label: GerLayQA eval set
nodes.rationale: QA; eval only; explicitly excluded from training.

nodes.label: German-LER scrub (flair/ner-german-legal)
nodes.rationale: PER, RR, AN, STR -> typed placeholders; runs before pretraining and before any index build; scrub log with hashed entities; runs in the isolated envs/scrub/ worker (P3-R1).

nodes.label: envs/scrub/ isolated uv project
nodes.rationale: Decision 22: flair requires transformers < 5, so it lives in its own uv project with its own lock; the main .venv keeps transformers 5 and never imports flair; check_env.py --scrub covers it.

nodes.label: MinHash dedup (datasketch)
nodes.rationale: 5-gram shingles, 128 permutations, Jaccard >= 0.8, exact-hash pre-pass.

nodes.label: Changelog / currency subset
nodes.rationale: Provisions amended since a date (GII Stand, RIS Inkrafttreten, Fedlex versions) -> data/manifests/changelog.jsonl; P9-B's currency subset with the valid-on filter on/off.

nodes.label: EOS-delimited packing
nodes.rationale: <|endoftext|> after every document, doc_ids incremented after the EOS, parquet shards with input_ids, doc_ids, source, licence, commercial_safe at row lengths 4,096 and 8,192; leftovers carried to the next row.

nodes.label: By-document validation split
nodes.rationale: Random 0.1%, minimum 2,000 documents, asserted.

nodes.label: Pretraining mixture (legal 70 / general 30)
nodes.rationale: configs/dataset/mixture_pretrain.yaml: per-source weights; arm commercial_safe vs research.

nodes.label: SFT / RAG prompt format
nodes.rationale: The RAG prompt is ONE document (no <|endoftext|> inside): <|question|> ... <|passage|><|c1|> sentence-numbered text ... <|/passage|> ... <|answer|>; targets carry pointers and end in <|endoftext|>; <|unanswerable|> items (20–30%).

nodes.label: Tokenizer fertility measurement
nodes.rationale: R4 applied to data: prediction 'Qwen3 < 1.8 tokens/word on a 1M-word DACH legal sample; GPT-2 > 2.2' written before scripts/measure_fertility.py runs; outcome in analysis/tokenizer_fertility.md.

nodes.label: Validation perplexity
nodes.rationale: Primary screen metric; two-seed mean compared against the bar.

nodes.label: Late-25% PPL
nodes.rationale: PPL over the last quarter of the row; the long-context lever (d_state, stage B at 8,192) is judged on it.

nodes.label: MQAR probe
nodes.rationale: Multi-query associative recall generator with the reference's mqar.yaml semantics.

nodes.label: Statute-recall probe
nodes.rationale: Given a § in context, reproduce Absatz 2 verbatim; exact-match and char-F1.

nodes.label: Multi-hop probe
nodes.rationale: Two-hop cross-reference questions built from statutes that cite another §; 200 items; exact-match; run from the first screen because a multi-hop deficit can hide behind mean PPL (FL13).

nodes.label: Citation precision
nodes.rationale: Pointer resolves + NLI entails; the verifier log is the metric; SFT >= 0.85, DPO >= 0.95 predicted; GRPO triggered only if a hybrid seed < 0.95 after DPO.

nodes.label: Quote fidelity
nodes.rationale: Exact match after NFC + whitespace normalisation; 100% by construction for pointer-rendering systems.

nodes.label: Refusal precision/recall/F1
nodes.rationale: On unanswerable and false-premise items.

nodes.label: Truncation rate / audit
nodes.rationale: Must be 0% at the budget (all dev decodes end on EOS); 75% of the medical reports were cut (FL10); scripts/audit_truncation.py is the P8-N gate.

nodes.label: Retrieval metrics (nDCG@10, R@5/10/20, MRR)
nodes.rationale: Per jurisdiction on GerLeRB and GerDaLIR; BM25 / dense / fused / reranked arms.

nodes.label: General-German PPL (forgetting)
nodes.rationale: On a held-out FineWeb-2 shard; predicted within 5% of the backbone's after post-training.

nodes.label: Bootstrap CIs (1,000 resamples by question)
nodes.rationale: Reported beside the seed SD, never instead; scripts/bootstrap_compare.py per pair per seed.

nodes.label: S1 — hybrid_legal_base (control)
nodes.rationale: The control and the simplest arm; its two-seed SD sets the bar.

nodes.label: S0 — hybrid_legal_attn0 (no attention)
nodes.rationale: 9xM3 + 3xL; not parameter-matched (+2.8%, delta reported); predicted to lose statute-recall and multi-hop.

nodes.label: S2 — hybrid_legal_attn4 (four attention layers)

nodes.rationale: -0.75%; predicted within the bar on PPL and worse on late-position PPL.

nodes.rationale: Head params reported; predicted within the bar.

nodes.label: configs/model/ref_transformer.yaml

nodes.label: Retriever (BM25 + dense + RRF + rerank)
nodes.rationale: Statute chunks at §/Artikel with hierarchy and version dates; case law by Tenor/Tatbestand/Gründe then 300–500-token windows with Randnummer anchors; jurisdiction and valid-on filters; top 50 -> 3–8 chunks <= 4K tokens.

nodes.label: chunk_statute
nodes.rationale: §/Artikel units with hierarchy Gesetz -> Abschnitt -> § -> Absatz -> Satz, valid_from/to, sentence ids sJ, from Document.sections.

nodes.label: chunk_case_law
nodes.rationale: Tenor / Tatbestand / Entscheidungsgründe, then 300–500-token windows with Randnummer anchors.

nodes.label: BM25 index (bm25s)
nodes.rationale: German stemming/stopwords; scripts/build_index.py --kind bm25.

nodes.label: Dense index (BAAI/bge-m3)
nodes.rationale: FAISS or numpy index built on 1 GPU by scripts/slurm/build_dense_index.sh.

nodes.label: Reranker (BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3)
nodes.rationale: top 50 -> 3–8 chunks <= 4K tokens.

nodes.label: Retrieval filters (jurisdiction, valid-on, doc_type)
nodes.rationale: DE/AT/CH/EU; valid-on date; index.py manifest of index versions with a nightly re-sync stub.

nodes.label: Renderer
nodes.rationale: <|q|><|cK|><|sJ|> -> the exact sentence text in quotes with its citation_id label; <|cite|><|cK|> -> (BGB §573 Abs. 2 Nr. 1); appends the notice; refuses pointers outside the retrieved set.

nodes.label: Verifier (sentence-level pipeline)
nodes.rationale: pointer resolves -> quote string-matches (NFC + whitespace) -> NLI entailment -> party-identity rule; failing sentences removed; a failing main claim -> 'Die bereitgestellten Quellen beantworten diese Frage nicht.'; the verifier log is the citation-precision metric; nothing unverified reaches the user.

nodes.label: NLI entailment check (mDeBERTa-v3-base-xnli)
nodes.rationale: MoritzLaurer/mDeBERTa-v3-base-xnli-multilingual-nli-2mil7; threshold 0.5 pre-registered in pre_registered.P7 before scripts/calibrate_nli.py runs on a 100-pair hand-built set; ships unless precision < 0.85.

nodes.label: Party-identity rule
nodes.rationale: Reject any answer containing a PER placeholder or a name matched by the LER model; 'who was the party' -> refusal (R11).

nodes.label: 'Hinweis: keine Rechtsberatung' notice
nodes.rationale: 'Hinweis: Dies ist eine rechtliche Information, keine Rechtsberatung.' appended to every answer by the renderer; EU AI Act Art. 50 transparency framing in the README (P10-A).

nodes.label: Retrieval gating
nodes.rationale: The decoder may cite only pointers into the retrieved set (PointerFSM), the renderer refuses pointers outside it, and the verifier removes anything that does not resolve, match or entail; the combination is what makes the system citation-faithful by construction.

nodes.label: scripts/answer.py end-to-end CLI
nodes.rationale: question -> retrieve -> build the P3-Y prompt -> decode with pointer FSM and best-of-n -> render -> verify -> print; runnable on CPU with a tiny checkpoint.

nodes.label: SFT on the pointer format
nodes.rationale: lexhybrid/training/sft_module.py: loss on answer tokens only, pointer tokens supervised; 20–30% unanswerable items; every target ends in <|endoftext|>; scripts/train_sft_hf.py for the Qwen3-0.6B baseline on the same data and steps.

nodes.label: DPO / KTO on verifier pass/fail pairs
nodes.rationale: scripts/build_dpo_pairs.py: best-of-n samples from each SFT model, verifier pass vs fail, coverage balanced; lexhybrid/training/dpo_module.py.

nodes.label: GRPO (conditional)
nodes.rationale: Only if any hybrid seed's citation precision after DPO < 0.95: verifier reward + coverage term + length penalty; stop when precision >= 0.95 or after 2,000 steps (FL12 reward hacking).

nodes.label: Synthetic QA generation (Qwen3-32B in vLLM)
nodes.rationale: Over real retrieved passages from P7; 20–30% unanswerable / false-premise / party-identity questions; answers in the pointer format; verifier-filtered; open teacher only (R10).

nodes.label: .venv-vllm environment
nodes.rationale: Separate from .venv because vLLM pins torch; scripts/slurm/setup_vllm.sh and vllm_smoke.sh.

nodes.label: Qwen3-0.6B baseline through the same pipeline
nodes.rationale: 1 seed; predicted ahead on multi-hop by more than the SD.

nodes.label: Jurist annotation kit
nodes.rationale: analysis/annotation_kit/: 200–300 questions with retrieved passages and the three systems' answers, blinded; double-annotation instructions; agreement sheet; results return in P9-H, until then the row says 'pending'.

nodes.label: Retrieval-copy floor baseline
nodes.rationale: Top-ranked passage verbatim; the hybrid must beat it on citation-faithful answer accuracy at all 3 seeds.

nodes.label: gpt-oss-120b ceiling
nodes.rationale: In vLLM with the same passages and the same pointer prompt on 4 GPUs; if it does not fit or load, ticked as skipped and said so in the writeup.

nodes.label: Efficiency evaluation at 8K / 32K / 128K
nodes.rationale: Efficiency-only for a model trained at 8K: cached decode tokens/s, time-to-first-token, memory per session, best-of-n cost, P4 profiler ladder re-run; predicted >= 4x the Transformer's tokens/s at 32K with flat memory.

nodes.label: analysis/legal_results.md

nodes.label: analysis/backbone_results.md

nodes.label: analysis/profile_results.md

nodes.label: analysis/corpus_manifest.md

nodes.label: analysis/param_counts.md

nodes.label: Docs/RUNBOOK.md

nodes.label: analysis/ARCHIVE_MANIFEST.md
nodes.rationale: What may leave the cluster (commercial-safe checkpoints, analysis/, manifests without text) and what may not (anything touched by research_only data; raw NC text).

nodes.label: analysis/LITERATURE_CHECK.md
nodes.rationale: Prior-work check for 'Mamba + xLSTM + sparse attention + pointer citations + verifier on DACH law' before the word 'first' appears anywhere.

nodes.label: EU AI Act Art. 50 transparency framing
Docs/CONVERSION_DESIGN.md (Qwen3 conversion)
nodes.rationale: MOHAWK/MambaInLlama-style initialisation of Mamba-3 in_proj slices from Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B Q/K/V/O, 25% of layers kept as attention, layer-wise alignment, KL against Qwen3-8B-Base, then P8's pipeline.

nodes.label: scripts/plan_state.py
nodes.rationale: stdlib only; init|sync|resume|section|tick|note|next-action|phase|next|block|unblock|job|artifact|evidence|verdict|show|session-end|check|readme with tick guards (phase, USER ACTION, sbatch evidence); the only writer of legal_build_state.json.

nodes.label: legal_build_state.json
nodes.rationale: The resumable record; written only by the helper.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md
nodes.rationale: <= 120 lines: bootstrap command, awk fallback, rules (a)–(m), command table, hostname rule.

nodes.label: scripts/validate.sh
nodes.rationale: Gates: 0 plan_state check; 1 environment (uv lock --check, check_env.py); 2 static (ruff, bash -n, shellcheck); 3 Hydra invariants (check_configs.py); 4 pytest with the §8.3 selection; 5 CPU forward/backward over all mixers (smoke_model.py); 6 repository hygiene; modes default / --full / --ci.

nodes.label: scripts/check_env.py
nodes.rationale: Interpreter equals .python-version; every installed distribution equals its uv.lock pin (uv export --frozen); torch.version.cuda == 12.8 on Linux, None on macOS; parses uv output under FORCE_COLOR=1 after CI run 36322586655.

nodes.label: scripts/check_repo_hygiene.py
nodes.rationale: Fails on files > 5 MB, checkpoints/data outside tests/fixtures/, a Reference/ directory in CI, CRLF, case-insensitive path collisions, secret-shaped strings, shell scripts without a shebang, and critical files that .gitignore would exclude.

nodes.label: scripts/check_operator_equivalence.py
nodes.rationale: R1_TOLERANCE = 1e-4; operator, boundary-inside-chunk, model-logit and compile gates; run on GPU by scripts/slurm/equivalence.sh with --chunk-sizes 64 128 --compile.

nodes.label: scripts/performance_profile.py
nodes.rationale: --sweep --backward --per-layer --decode --attn-backend --chunk-size --compile --dtype; median timing, OOM rows, log-log exponent fit, effective_chunk_size read back.

nodes.label: scripts/screen_arms.py
nodes.rationale: Arm(config, overrides, seed, isolates, expect, walltime) table for S0–S6; list|env|verify [--full]; verify builds each arm through HybridConfig.from_hydra and asserts its expect tokens appear in the ARCH fingerprint; --full asserts the parameter band.

nodes.label: scripts/train_pretrain.py
nodes.rationale: Hydra entry: PretrainLightningModule, DDPStrategy, the val_check_interval product, write_run_metadata, ARCH print.

nodes.label: scripts/evaluate_probes.py
nodes.rationale: Runs MQAR, statute-recall and multi-hop on any checkpoint.

nodes.label: scripts/evaluate_citation.py
nodes.rationale: Citation precision/recall, quote fidelity, refusal P/R/F1, answer accuracy where gold exists; per-question JSONL for the bootstrap.

nodes.label: scripts/bootstrap_compare.py
nodes.rationale: Paired bootstrap over per-item metric files (--metrics-a/-b JSONL); the claim rule applied verbatim per metric.

nodes.label: scripts/verify_handoff.py
nodes.rationale: Builds HybridLanguageModel from a yaml, loads model.-prefixed keys from last.ckpt; PASS = 0 missing / 0 unexpected.

nodes.label: scripts/evaluate_lm.py
nodes.rationale: Perplexity, bits-per-token, throughput ladder, peak memory; --dataset takes a packed parquet shard path.

nodes.label: scripts/dump_reference_parity.py
nodes.rationale: Imports the reference by path, builds each block at dim 64 and a 4-layer model (vocab 256 to stay under the 5 MB hygiene limit), writes tests/fixtures/reference_parity/<type>.pt and model.pt.

nodes.label: Reference parity fixtures and tests/test_reference_parity.py
nodes.rationale: Blocks at max|delta| <= 1e-6, whole-model logits and loss <= 5e-6 (macOS arm64 fixtures differ from Linux x86_64 BLAS by up to 1.4e-6, CI run 36322991795), identical beam-search tokens; never skipped; the record since Reference/ was deleted (FL2).

nodes.label: tests/test_numerics_fp64.py
nodes.rationale: DELTAS, CHUNKS, TOL = 1e-6, xfail(strict=True) for legacy; SSD, TFLA, selective scan, step = forward, packed = per-document, final-state and fp32-state checks; CPU-collected, never CUDA-gated.

nodes.label: tests/test_port_map.py
nodes.rationale: Every P1 destination exists and is not gitignored; no hybrid_xmamba or cu_seqlens string under lexhybrid/ scripts/ tests/; no sys.path.insert in scripts; no git call in lexhybrid/ or scripts/.

nodes.label: tests/test_slurm_wrappers.py
nodes.rationale: Every wrapper: --partition=aisc-batch, --account=aisc, --gpus not --gres, --exclude=ga03,gx17v1,gx13v1, --requeue + --open-mode=append on training wrappers, %A_%a logs on arrays, ARM resolved inside, no git call, cd "${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR}".

nodes.label: tests/test_ci_workflow.py
nodes.rationale: Keeps ci.yml and validate.sh in step: uv sync --locked everywhere, no pip install, matrix contains .python-version, marker selections equal §8.3.

nodes.label: tests/test_config_invariants.py
nodes.rationale: Hydra compose of every yaml; recurrent yamls pin operators; exact reference parameter counts; test_param_bands writes analysis/param_counts.md.

nodes.label: tests/test_gpu.py and tests/test_multigpu.py
nodes.rationale: cuda: SDPA flash vs math in bf16, flex vs dense on GPU, SSD/TFLA bf16-autocast vs fp32, compile vs eager at 1e-4, cached decode on GPU, peak-memory sanity; multigpu: 2-process DDP step with identical gradients across ranks; both skip with reason on the Mac and in CI.

nodes.label: .github/workflows/ci.yml
nodes.rationale: Decision 19: jobs lint, test (Python 3.11 and 3.12), hygiene, package on every push and PR; macos and network weekly/manual; astral-sh/setup-uv + uv sync --locked everywhere; read-only permissions; concurrency cancels superseded runs; inert until the user pushes.

nodes.label: Pytest markers (slow, cuda, multigpu, linux_only, network, reference)
nodes.rationale: Declared under --strict-markers; conftest skips with a stated reason: linux_only unless Linux, cuda unless CUDA, multigpu unless two devices, network unless LEXHYBRID_NETWORK_TESTS=1, reference when Reference/ is absent; the reference's [tool:pytest] in pytest.ini was ignored (defect 14).

nodes.label: Coverage floor
nodes.rationale: P1-W5 sets [tool.coverage.report] fail_under to the measured lexhybrid/ line coverage rounded down to the nearest 5; raised by phases that add coverage, never lowered without a note.

nodes.label: uv-locked environment (decision 18)
nodes.rationale: One uv.lock for macOS arm64 and Linux x86_64; .python-version 3.11 (the cluster interpreter); torch==2.11.0 everywhere (PyPI wheel on macOS, 2.11.0+cu128 on Linux — the newest build for the cluster's CUDA 12.8 driver, torch 2.12+ has no cu128 build); every environment built with uv sync --locked; a dependency change is a box of its own (FL15).

nodes.label: scripts/sync_to_cluster.sh
nodes.rationale: rsync -az --delete --exclude-from=.rsync-exclude; writes .sync_stamp = ISO date + tree hash before syncing; the .rsync-exclude include rule for tests/fixtures/** must precede the *.pt exclude (rsync is first-match-wins).

nodes.label: scripts/sync_from_cluster.sh
nodes.rationale: Pulls only logs/ or analysis/ into cluster/<subdir>/, never --delete, never outputs/.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/cluster.env
nodes.rationale: Gitignored; CLUSTER_HOST (ssh alias), CLUSTER_REPO=/sc/home/<user>/lexhybrid, SCRATCH_ROOT=/sc/scratch/<user>/lexhybrid.

nodes.label: SLURM wrappers (scripts/slurm/*.sh)
nodes.rationale: Anything scripted on the cluster is a scripts/slurm/*.sh with an #SBATCH header; port map §11 headers; ARM resolved inside the job; --gpus never --gres; training wrappers --requeue + --open-mode=append and pass last.ckpt as ckpt_path.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/setup_env.sh
nodes.rationale: CPU job, --exclude=ga03, installs uv if missing, uv sync --locked, then check_env.py.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/fetch_hf.sh
nodes.rationale: CPU job, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0; downloads Qwen3-1.7B/8B/0.6B-Base, flair/ner-german-legal, bge-m3, bge-reranker-v2-m3, the NLI model into $HF_HOME.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/preflight.sh
nodes.rationale: CPU job: screen_arms.py verify --full; pytest -m 'not cuda and not slow and not reference'; ARCH line printed for every arm; 'PRE-FLIGHT PASSED'.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/gpu_tests.sh
nodes.rationale: 1 H100: pytest -m cuda tests/ plus check_env.py; job 2588779 found compile drift on GPU.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/multigpu_tests.sh
nodes.rationale: 2 H100: pytest -m multigpu tests/; sbatch --gpus=2.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/build_corpus_array.sh
nodes.rationale: CPU array, one task per collector, --limit unset, writes data/raw/<src> and manifests on scratch.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/pack_corpus.sh
nodes.rationale: scrub -> dedup -> pack at 4,096 and 8,192; commercial-safe and research arms as separate shard sets.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/probe_ckpt_size.sh
nodes.rationale: 10-step hybrid_legal_base run on 1 GPU writing last.ckpt to scratch; measures checkpoint GB for the §6 storage row.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/profile.sh
nodes.rationale: point() protocol: one length per process, fresh TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR; ref_hybrid_m3 sanity at 16,384; legal base and Transformer inference at 2,048/8,192/16,384 and training at 2,048/4,096/8,192 with and without packed doc_ids.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/equivalence.sh
nodes.rationale: check_operator_equivalence.py --chunk-sizes 64 128 --compile on GPU; exit 0 at 1e-4.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/kd_memory_probe.sh
nodes.rationale: 4xH100 DDP, 20 steps each: 1.7B and 8B teacher at 4,096 and 8,192 rows; records s/step and peak GB per rank; decides the teacher.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/watch.sh
nodes.rationale: squeue/sacct/preemption/per-run checkpoint listing/log error grep; source-able; no python.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/screen_array.sh
nodes.rationale: Array header; ARMS env list; ARM resolved on the compute node by screen_arms.py env; unset EXPERIMENT; SAVE_TOP_K=0; greps the ARCH line at step 0 against the arm's expect tokens; delegates to train_pretrain_1gpu.sh.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/train_pretrain_4gpu.sh
nodes.rationale: --gpus=4, --mem=256G, --cpus-per-task=32, --time=3-00:00:00, --requeue, --open-mode=append; passes last.ckpt as +resume_from_checkpoint= when present; NUM_GPUS check; du -sh outputs first.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/verify_handoff.sh
nodes.rationale: CPU job running verify_handoff.py on each last.ckpt against its yaml.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/eval_probes.sh
nodes.rationale: 1 GPU; evaluate_probes.py on every arm's last.ckpt at 2,048 (P5) and 8,192 (P6).

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/build_dense_index.sh
nodes.rationale: 1 GPU; bge-m3 embeddings; index size and docs/s recorded.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/eval_retrieval.sh
nodes.rationale: nDCG@10, R@5/10/20, MRR per jurisdiction on GerLeRB and GerDaLIR; BM25 / dense / fused / reranked arms.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/train_sft_4gpu.sh
nodes.rationale: SFT for hybrid and Transformer seeds 42/43/44 on 4xH100.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/eval_quality.sh
nodes.rationale: Currency subset, general-German PPL, probes at 8K over all seven systems.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/eval_efficiency.sh
nodes.rationale: 8K / 32K / 128K, one length per process.

nodes.label: scripts/slurm/eval_ceiling.sh
nodes.rationale: gpt-oss-120b in vLLM on 4 GPUs; skipped and said so if it does not load.

nodes.label: Docs/REFERENCE_PORT_MAP.md
nodes.rationale: Source -> destination for every module, verbatim signatures, the 18 defects with line references, SLURM headers, env block, WSD formula, ARCH format, oracle-test structure, validate gates, gitignore guards, handoff recipe, measured numbers, incidents, stack.

nodes.label: Docs/Hybrid Mamba–xLSTM Codebase Review and DACH Legal AI Blueprint.md
nodes.rationale: Read once on 2026-09-27; cited by section from the port map, never re-read wholesale; its bands map onto the phases in §12.

nodes.label: Reference/hybrid_model_mamba_xlstm (medical reference)
nodes.rationale: The finished medical research codebase (hybrid Mamba-3 + mLSTM + attention for chest-X-ray report generation, PyTorch Lightning + Hydra, measured on the HPI aisc H100 cluster) whose backbone, kernels, decode cache, packing, tests and measurement discipline are ported; read-only and deleted at P1-Z.

nodes.label: HPI aisc H100 cluster
nodes.rationale: Partition aisc-batch, account aisc; nodes ga03 (ARM), gx17v1 and gx13v1 (faulty GPU) excluded; outputs/ on $SCRATCH_ROOT; 200 GB home quota untouched; >= 300 GB scratch needed.

nodes.label: Stage A (4,096 rows) / Stage B (8,192 rows)
nodes.rationale: Stage A: 90% of the token budget at 4,096 rows (micro-batch 8 x accum 2 x 4 GPUs); Stage B: last 10% at 8,192 rows (micro-batch 4 x accum 4) resumed from stage A's last.ckpt with the WSD decay re-anchored; training at 8K uncompiled costs 54 GB (FL14).

nodes.label: FL1 Silent config drop
nodes.rationale: A lever reaches the yaml but not the mixer (the reference's costliest failure); early warning: ARCH line at step 0 lacks the arm's expect token; mitigation: screen_arms.py verify --full in preflight, wrapper greps the ARCH line, from_hydra everywhere.

nodes.label: FL2 Port diverges from the reference after a fix
nodes.rationale: Early warning: test_reference_parity.py red; mitigation: fixtures dumped before deletion, never skipped; every defect fix ships its own test.

nodes.label: FL3 Licence contamination
nodes.rationale: A research_only row in a commercial_safe shard or any licence=unknown; mitigation: build_corpus refuses unknown, shard test in validate.sh, the register is the single source.

nodes.label: FL4 Checkpoint bloat / quota
nodes.rationale: ~4.3 GB per checkpoint; du -sh $HOME > 150 GB; mitigation: outputs/ on scratch, SAVE_TOP_K=0 on arms, 1 + last on pipeline runs, du before every submission.

nodes.label: FL5 Preemption restarts from step 0
nodes.rationale: Two ARCH lines in one log; sacct shows REQUEUED; mitigation: --open-mode=append, SignalCheckpointCallback, wrapper passes ckpt_path=last.ckpt, test_slurm_wrappers.py.

nodes.label: FL6 Login-node execution
nodes.rationale: 'This command is not allowed on the login node!'; mitigation: CLAUDE.md allowlist, ARM resolved inside the job, nothing scripted outside sbatch.

nodes.label: FL7 Executor drift on the plan itself
nodes.rationale: check fails, ticks without notes, wrong phase; mitigation: check as gate 0, tick guards, resume prints only the current phase.

nodes.label: FL8 KD memory: full-vocab KL at 4K rows
nodes.rationale: OOM at P4-T; mitigation: slab-wise KL under checkpointing, teacher decided by measurement.

nodes.label: FL9 Exact TFLA on the sequential fallback at init
nodes.rationale: test_tfla_fast_path_at_init red; step time 5x the profile; mitigation: mlstm_forget_gate_bias_init 3.0, fallback is an error unless configured.

nodes.label: FL10 Truncation / no stop condition
nodes.rationale: 75% of the medical reports were cut; any dev decode without EOS; mitigation: EOS on every SFT target, P8-N audit gate at 0%.

nodes.label: FL11 Underpowered screen
nodes.rationale: S1 seed SD > 0.5 PPL; mitigation: S1 seeds first, bar floor 0.10, a null is recorded as a null.

nodes.label: FL12 GRPO reward hacking
nodes.rationale: Trivially entailed citations, over-refusal; citation precision up while accuracy or coverage down; mitigation: coverage term, stop rule, GRPO only when the pre-registered condition holds.

nodes.label: FL13 Multi-hop deficit hidden by mean PPL
nodes.rationale: S0/S1 tie on PPL, differ on multi-hop; mitigation: multi-hop probe from the first screen, reported in every table.

nodes.label: FL14 Training-side cost at long rows
nodes.rationale: 54 GB at 8K uncompiled; stage-B step time > 3x stage A; mitigation: budget the uncompiled path, compile only after P4-S, micro-batch 4 at 8K.

nodes.label: FL15 Environment drift between Mac, CI and cluster
nodes.rationale: uv lock --check fails, check_env.py mismatch, CI red on one platform; mitigation: one uv.lock, uv sync --locked everywhere, check_env.py in validate, CI and every cluster job.

nodes.label: FL16 Green on macOS, broken on Linux
nodes.rationale: Case-insensitive paths, gcc/Inductor, flex on CPU, the cu128 build; CI test red while local validate is green; mitigation: Linux-only tests in CI on every push; the cluster build of torch is the one CI installs.

hyperedges.label: Citation-faithful answer pipeline (retrieve -> decode with pointer FSM -> render -> verify)
Pre-registered screen arms S0–S6 (OFAT ladder against S1)
Mixers selected by layer_pattern inside HybridBlock
